purpose: Test whether the frozen V3 singleton-corroboration exception for semantically strong identifier kinds produces natural adopted-bridge opportunities without using treatment outcomes for selection.
eligibility: task has a completed historical OFF-only difficulty-screen run
before a later rg search, a structured identifier is present in exactly one bounded prior observable rg output
the identifier is classified by frozen extraction as exception, request_id, or test_name
the identifier has no positive local cue in prior evidence, so ordinary V1 eligibility would not admit the singleton
the later agent rg query explicitly reuses the same identifier
the frozen target-aware V3 builder admits that identifier for the later search result
selection_rule: sort eligible task IDs ascending; select first 3, or all eligible tasks if fewer than 3
evaluation_after_selection: deterministic matched OFF/ON replay on identical captured requests; no fresh agent reruns required
interpretation: treatment-blind mechanism validation, not a fresh-agent success estimate
